privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Sarasota Flooring Company
privacy.description: Plain-language privacy policy for sarasotaflooringcompany.com: what the estimate form collects, how Web3Forms and Cloudflare Pages handle it, your choices.
privacy.h1: How We Handle the Information You Share
privacy.lede: No ad trackers, no cookies we set ourselves, no sold data. Here's exactly what the estimate form collects and what happens to it after you hit submit.
privacy.html:
This is a short, plain-language privacy policy for sarasotaflooringcompany.com. We don't run ad trackers or sell data, and this page explains what actually happens when you use the site.

What we collect

The estimate form and contact form on this site ask for your name, phone number, email, general address or area, and a description of your project. That information is submitted through Web3Forms, a third-party form-processing service, and delivered to us by email at hello@sarasotaflooringcompany.com. We use it to reply to your request, and for nothing else.

Cookies and tracking

We don't set cookies of our own on this site, and we don't run third-party ad-tracking scripts. This site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages, and Cloudflare's infrastructure may log standard technical request data, such as IP address and browser type, for security and performance; that logging happens at the hosting layer, separate from anything we configure ourselves.

How your information is used

Information submitted through a form is used to respond to your estimate or contact request: scheduling a visit, answering a question, or following up on a quote. We don't sell, rent, or share it with third parties for marketing. Web3Forms, as the form processor, handles the technical delivery of your submission to our inbox; its own privacy terms govern that step.

Email retention

We keep submitted messages in our email inbox so we can reference them if you contact us again about the same project. We don't maintain a separate marketing database or mailing list from form submissions.

External links

Pages on this site link to outside sources, including building codes, standards organizations, and county permitting pages, for the facts we cite. Those sites have their own privacy practices, separate from ours.

Your choices

You can ask what information we have on file, or ask us to delete it, by emailing hello@sarasotaflooringcompany.com. If you'd rather not use the web form at all, call or text (941) 241-3724 instead.

Changes to this policy

If how we handle data changes, such as a new form tool or a new host, we'll update this page. Check back here, or ask, if you want to know what's current.

Email hello@sarasotaflooringcompany.com with questions about this policy or about a submission made through the request form. See also our terms of service and about page.
